method: Inspected all specified local PNGs using view_image. Contact sheets were used for page density, margin, heading and broad overflow checks; the six requested full-page images were inspected for readable text, glyphs, formula layout and equation tags. No rebuild, PDF modification, source modification, or mathematical verification was performed.

findings.location: R64 Section 1, equation (1), second display row
findings.description: The long second row ends with Sigma>7/12 immediately adjacent to the equation tag (1). There is no visible horizontal gutter, so the tag visually reads as attached to the formula. The row remains on the page; this is a formula/tag spacing collision rather than edge clipping.
findings.suggested_layout_action: Break the second display row before the final Sigma condition, or otherwise reserve a separate equation-number gutter. This is a layout suggestion only; no edit was made.

findings.location: R48 Section 1, first paragraph, after the inline A_i at the end of the first line
findings.description: The sentence-ending period wraps alone to the beginning of the next line before 'Then'. Text remains legible and nothing is clipped or overlapped.
findings.suggested_layout_action: Keep the sentence-ending punctuation with the preceding inline math if adjusting typography. No edit was made.

other_observations: No other obvious page-edge clipping, text/formula overlap, missing-glyph boxes, or black replacement glyphs were seen in the assigned images.
The sampled full-page module titles and section headings have visible following content and consistent hierarchy; no isolated heading without its opening content was seen in those samples.
The full-page samples on 199, 245 and 248 show readable Greek symbols, subscripts, fractions, inequalities and numbered formulas within the page margins.
The final evidence-index page 277 has clear headings, bullets and readable endmatter. Long archive names wrap across lines; these do not appear clipped.

Several contact-sheet pages have substantial white space at module transitions, including page 223. This appears consistent with starting the next technical part on a new page and is not treated as a clipping or overlap defect.
limitations: The contact sheets reduce page resolution, so absence of an obvious defect there is not a character-level audit of every equation on all 85 pages.
Only the six specified pages were inspected at full-page image resolution. Other pages were checked through the supplied contact sheets.

This report concerns rendered appearance only. It does not establish mathematical correctness, source fidelity, global premise transfer, searchable PDF text quality, accessibility or print-production compliance.
The report records the supplied renders; no post-correction render was generated or reviewed by this agent.
